headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard made a jumper with 0.4 seconds remaining, and the Los Angeles Clippers rallied from a 24-point deficit to beat the Indiana Pacers 114-113 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kawhi Leonard's jumper sends Clippers past Pacers 114-113 after they come from 24 down

headlines.description: — Payton Pritchard scored 36 points, Jayson Tatum had 26 points and 12 rebounds, and the Boston Celtics beat the Atlanta Hawks 109-102 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pritchard and Tatum help Celtics beat the Hawks 109-102 without Brown

headlines.description: — Max Strus scored 29 points, Evan Mobley had 23 and Jarrett Allen came back from injury to add 18, leading the Cleveland Cavaliers to a 149-128 win over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Strus makes eight 3s scores 29, Jarrett Allen returns as Cavs roll to 149-128 win over Heat

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 25 points and led a fourth-quarter rally as the Houston Rockets pulled away from the Memphis Grizzlies with a 119-109 victory Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant scored 25 points and leads fourth-quarter push as Rockets beat Grizzlies 119-109

events.name: Chicago Bulls at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 25 points, and the Oklahoma City Thunder used a 22-0 second-half run to power a 131-113 win over the Chicago Bulls on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 25 and the Thunder use a 22-0 second-half run to beat the Bulls 131-113

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Toronto Raptors

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes had 23 points and 12 assists, Jakob Poeltl had 18 points and 11 rebounds, and the Toronto Raptors beat the New Orleans Pelicans 119-106 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raptors beat the Pelicans 119-106 as Barnes has 23 points and 12 assists

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 33 points, 16 rebounds and 12 assists, Cam Johnson and Jamal Murray combined for four 3-pointers in the final 2:20, and the Denver Nuggets rallied from 13 down in the fourth quarter to beat the Utah Jazz 135-129 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic's triple-double, Murray and Johnson hit late 3s to rally Nuggets by Jazz, 135-129

events.name: Washington Wizards at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Kristaps Porzingis had 28 points and eight assists, Gui Santos made a pair of free throws with 11.4 seconds remaining, and the Golden State Warriors held off the Washington Wizards 131-126 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porzingis and Santos come up big for Warriors in 131-126 win over Wizards

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Marvin Bagley III scored a season-high 26 points off the bench and Cooper Flagg had 24 to lead the Dallas Mavericks past the Portland Trail Blazers 100-93 on Friday night, snapping a five-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bagley scores 26 points and Mavericks snap a 5-game skid in a 100-93 win against Trail Blazers

events.name: Brooklyn Nets at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 41 points and eight rebounds while also picking up his suspension-triggering 16th technical foul during the Los Angeles Lakers ' 116-99 victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Friday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic scores 41 points and gets his 16th technical foul in Lakers' 116-99 win over Nets
